title: Conclusion Brief Indication Concerning The 4 Truths Of The 3rd Stopping Place

questions.question: Who is spoken about at the beginning of the target passage?
questions.answer: An eager traveler who is searching for truths of belief.

questions.question: How many great truths are mentioned as being seen at the Third Stopping-Place?
questions.answer: Four great truths.

questions.question: What main belief is strongly stated in the long passage about Allah?
questions.answer: That only Allah is worthy of worship and that He is One.

questions.question: What is one truth connected to the opening of forms?
questions.answer: Living things are given their many forms in a complete and perfect way.

questions.question: About how many kinds of living beings are mentioned?
questions.answer: Four hundred thousand species.

questions.question: Which two fields of study are named as witnesses for the variety of living things?
questions.answer: Biology and botany.

questions.question: What is said about mercifulness in the passage?
questions.answer: It is wide-reaching, orderly, and without lacking anything.

questions.question: How is that mercifulness known according to the passage?
questions.answer: It can be seen clearly by observing the world.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the managing of living beings?
questions.answer: All living beings are managed in an orderly way without mistakes or flaws.

questions.question: What two ideas are joined together near the end of the long statement about living things being fed?
questions.answer: Compassion and giving sustenance.

questions.question: When is sustenance given to those who need it?
questions.answer: It is given at the time of need.

questions.question: What does the passage say does not happen in Allah’s providing?
questions.answer: There is no mistake and no forgetfulness.

questions.question: Name two beautiful divine names used for Allah in this passage after the description of providing.
questions.answer: The Provider and the Merciful.

questions.question: What is said about Allah’s gifts and generosity?
questions.answer: They reach everywhere and include all.

questions.question: After the long statement, what does the prayer admit about human knowledge?
questions.answer: People only know what Allah teaches them.

questions.question: Which two divine qualities are named right after that admission of limited knowledge?
questions.answer: Allah is All-Knowing and All-Wise.

questions.question: Upon whom are peace and blessings asked in the prayer?
questions.answer: Upon Prophet Muhammad, his family, and all his companions.

questions.question: For whom is forgiveness asked besides the speaker?
questions.answer: For those who sincerely help copy and spread the Risale-i Nur, and also for fathers, teachers, shaykhs, sisters, brothers, and sincere students.

questions.question: Which group is specially mentioned at the end of the forgiveness request?
questions.answer: Those who write and copy that treatise.

questions.question: How does the prayer end?
questions.answer: With praise to Allah, the Lord and Sustainer of all worlds.

questions.question: What part of the traveler’s journey is being talked about in this passage?
questions.answer: The truths he witnessed at the Third Stopping-Place.

questions.question: How are the traveler’s insights described at the start?
questions.answer: They are described as brief signs of the light of belief.

questions.question: What sentence is the center of the long declaration in the passage?
questions.answer: That there is no god except Allah, the One and Unique.

questions.question: What does the passage say points to Allah’s oneness?
questions.answer: The witnessing of several great truths in creation points to His oneness.

questions.question: What is the first of those truths about?
questions.answer: It is about the opening and unfolding of forms in living beings.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the forms of living things?
questions.answer: They are made fully and without defect.

questions.question: What is special about mercifulness in this passage?
questions.answer: It covers everything in a regular and complete way.

questions.question: How is this mercy recognized?
questions.answer: It is recognized through what people can observe with their own eyes.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about the administration of living beings?
questions.answer: It teaches that all of them are directed in an organized way.

questions.question: What does the passage deny about this administration?
questions.answer: It denies any error or defect in it.

questions.question: What does the word “sustaining” point to in this passage?
questions.answer: It points to feeding and supporting all who need provision.

questions.question: Who receives this provision?
questions.answer: All creatures that take in sustenance.

questions.question: What does the timing of provision show?
questions.answer: It shows that needs are known and answered on time.

questions.question: What can we understand from the words that there is no forgetfulness in giving provision?
questions.answer: That Allah’s care is perfect and never fails.

questions.question: What does the prayer teach us to say about our own knowledge?
questions.answer: That our knowledge is only what Allah has taught us.

questions.question: What special act of worship is made for the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ in the prayer?
questions.answer: Asking Allah to send peace and blessings upon him.

questions.question: What work with the Risale-i Nur is praised in the prayer?
questions.answer: Sincerely writing, copying, and sharing it.

questions.question: Which family and community members are included in the prayer for forgiveness?
questions.answer: Fathers, teachers, spiritual elders, sisters, brothers, and sincere students.

questions.question: What final idea closes the prayer?
questions.answer: Praising Allah, the Sustainer of all worlds.

questions.question: What is being summarized very briefly at the start of the passage?
questions.answer: The faith-filled insights the traveler gained from four high truths.

questions.question: Where did the traveler witness those truths?
questions.answer: At the Third Stopping-Place.

questions.question: What basic message about Allah is repeated strongly in the passage?
questions.answer: Allah alone is God, and He is One.

questions.question: What kind of evidence is used in this passage to support belief?
questions.answer: Signs found in living things, mercy, order, and provision.

questions.question: How does the passage use the many forms of living beings as evidence?
questions.answer: Their many perfect forms show wise and complete creation.

questions.question: What number is used to show the great variety of life?
questions.answer: Four hundred thousand species.

questions.question: Why are plants and animals mentioned together?
questions.answer: Because both help show the wide range of life and design.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the truth of mercy?
questions.answer: It is broad, ordered, and missing nothing.

questions.question: What does “missing nothing” teach in this part?
questions.answer: That Allah’s mercy is complete.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the care and rule over all living beings?
questions.answer: It covers them all in a balanced and ordered way.

questions.question: What proof about Allah comes from the feeding of creatures?
questions.answer: That His compassion and care reach every creature in need.

questions.question: What words show that Allah’s providing is dependable?
questions.answer: It is given at the needed time without mistake or forgetting.

questions.question: What can a reader infer from the many divine names listed after the description of provision?
questions.answer: That Allah’s care has many beautiful sides, like mercy, kindness, and generosity.

questions.question: What does the line about gifts reaching all people and creatures tell us?
questions.answer: Allah’s giving is wide and not limited to a small group.

questions.question: After the declaration of faith, what is the first main lesson in the prayer?
questions.answer: People only know what Allah teaches them.

questions.question: For whose honor are blessings requested?
questions.answer: For Prophet Muhammad ﷺ.

questions.question: Besides the Prophet ﷺ, who else is included in those blessings?
questions.answer: His family and all his companions.

questions.question: What does the prayer ask Allah to do for the writer and helpers?
questions.answer: Forgive them.

questions.question: What kind of helpers are mentioned?
questions.answer: Those who sincerely help spread and copy the work.

questions.question: How does the very end of the passage direct our hearts?
questions.answer: Toward praising Allah.

questions.question: What kind of traveler is described in this passage?
questions.answer: A curious traveler looking for truth.

questions.question: What did he gain from the four truths mentioned here?
questions.answer: Light and understanding in belief.

questions.question: What belief sentence stands at the center of the passage?
questions.answer: That there is no god but Allah.

questions.question: What two words are used to show Allah’s oneness in a strong way?
questions.answer: One and Unique.

questions.question: What is the first large sign in creation described here?
questions.answer: The giving of many different forms to living creatures.

questions.question: How are those forms described?
questions.answer: Complete and free of flaws.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention a very large number of species?
questions.answer: To show the greatness and wide reach of Allah’s creating.

questions.question: What school subjects are named as supporting this sign?
questions.answer: Biology and botany.

questions.question: What second great sign is mentioned after the forms of living things?
questions.answer: The broad and regular truth of mercy.

questions.question: What makes that mercy easy to recognize?
questions.answer: It can be observed openly.

questions.question: What third truth is mentioned?
questions.answer: The organized management of all living beings.

questions.question: What does this management not contain?
questions.answer: It does not contain mistakes or defects.

questions.question: What fourth truth is mentioned?
questions.answer: Compassion together with sustaining creatures.

questions.question: What does it mean that provision comes at the right time?
questions.answer: Allah knows when each creature needs it.

questions.question: How does the passage show Allah’s care is reliable?
questions.answer: It says there is no error and no forgetting in His providing.

questions.question: What is one name of Allah in the passage that connects especially to food and provision?
questions.answer: The Provider.

questions.question: What does the prayer say about human knowledge compared to Allah’s knowledge?
questions.answer: Human knowledge is limited to what Allah teaches, while Allah knows all things.

questions.question: What service to Islamic learning is specially mentioned in the prayer?
questions.answer: Copying and sharing the treatise sincerely.

questions.question: Which people are remembered in the prayer for mercy and forgiveness?
questions.answer: The speaker, helpers, fathers, teachers, shaykhs, sisters, brothers, and sincere students.

questions.question: What is the last statement of the prayer about?
questions.answer: Praising Allah, the Lord of all worlds.

questions.question: At the beginning of the passage, what is being referred to in a very short way?
questions.answer: The lights of faith the traveler received from four great truths.

questions.question: What is the clearest main idea of the long Arabic statement and its meaning?
questions.answer: Allah alone is the true God, and creation points to His oneness.

questions.question: What does the passage say about Allah’s existence besides His oneness?
questions.answer: It points to His necessary and certain existence.

questions.question: What sign from living creatures is mentioned first?
questions.answer: The amazing forming of many kinds of living beings.

questions.question: Are these living forms described as weak and broken, or complete and sound?
questions.answer: Complete and sound.

questions.question: How many species are mentioned in that sign?
questions.answer: Four hundred thousand.

questions.question: Why is that number important for understanding the passage?
questions.answer: It helps show how vast Allah’s creating power is.

questions.question: What does the passage say about mercy?
questions.answer: It reaches widely and works in an orderly way.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about running the lives of creatures?
questions.answer: All living things are governed with order.

questions.question: What is absent from this government of creation?
questions.answer: Error and deficiency.

questions.question: How does the passage describe care for those who need food?
questions.answer: It includes all of them and reaches them when they need it.

questions.question: What can we learn from the phrase that provision comes without forgetfulness?
questions.answer: Allah never overlooks any creature.

questions.question: What do the names connected to mercy and generosity add to the meaning of the passage?
questions.answer: They show that Allah’s power is joined with kindness and giving.

questions.question: What is said about the reach of Allah’s giving?
questions.answer: His giving and generosity are for all.

questions.question: In the prayer, what confession is made before asking for blessings and forgiveness?
questions.answer: That people have no knowledge except what Allah teaches them.

questions.question: For whom are many blessings requested?
questions.answer: For Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, his family, and all his companions.

questions.question: What does the prayer ask for the people who help with the treatise?
questions.answer: That Allah forgive them.

questions.question: What attitude do those helpers need to have according to the prayer?
questions.answer: Sincerity.

questions.question: Which two groups of fellow believers are named in a warm family-like way?
questions.answer: Sisters and brothers.

questions.question: What is the prayer’s ending line of praise?
questions.answer: Praise belongs to Allah, the Sustainer of all worlds.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the traveler’s belief-related gains from the Third Stopping-Place?
questions.answer: They are bright insights taken from four lofty truths.

questions.question: What does the repeated focus on four truths help organize for the reader?
questions.answer: The main signs that point to Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: What is the first and strongest statement of faith in the passage?
questions.answer: That there is no deity except Allah.

questions.question: What does the passage say creation witnesses about Allah?
questions.answer: It witnesses that He is One and truly exists.

questions.question: Which truth is shown by the many forms of living things?
questions.answer: The truth that Allah opens and shapes life in many ways.

questions.question: What is remarkable about those forms?
questions.answer: They are made perfectly, without defect.

questions.question: How do the many species support the passage’s message?
questions.answer: They show a single Lord is creating countless kinds of life.

questions.question: What do biology and botany act like in this passage?
questions.answer: They act like signs or witnesses to the order in life.

questions.question: What is taught by the truth of mercifulness?
questions.answer: That mercy surrounds creation in a balanced and complete way.

questions.question: How is that mercy different from something hidden and impossible to notice?
questions.answer: It is visible and can be observed.

questions.question: What is meant by the truth of administering all living beings?
questions.answer: Allah manages and directs all life in order.

questions.question: What comparison can be made between human management and Allah’s management from this passage?
questions.answer: Human management can fail, but Allah’s care is described as free from mistakes and flaws.

questions.question: What does the truth of compassion and sustaining show?
questions.answer: That every creature needing provision is cared for.

questions.question: Why is “every time of need” an important phrase in meaning?
questions.answer: It shows Allah’s help comes with perfect timing.

questions.question: What do “no mistake” and “no forgetfulness” together teach?
questions.answer: Allah’s providing is exact and dependable.

questions.question: What picture of Allah comes from the names about mercy, kindness, and generosity?
questions.answer: A Lord who is loving, caring, and generous to His creation.

questions.question: What does the line about universal gifts tell us about Allah’s giving?
questions.answer: It is broad and reaches all parts of creation.

questions.question: What humble truth about ourselves is spoken in the prayer?
questions.answer: We do not know anything unless Allah teaches us.

questions.question: Which two qualities of Allah are named right after that?
questions.answer: All-Knowing and All-Wise.

questions.question: What important sunnah-like practice appears in the prayer for the Prophet ﷺ?
questions.answer: Sending peace and blessings upon him.

questions.question: What kinds of people are remembered in the prayer for forgiveness besides the speaker?
questions.answer: Helpers, family elders, teachers, spiritual elders, sisters, brothers, sincere students, and copyists.

questions.question: Why are the people who write and copy the treatise mentioned especially?
questions.answer: Because they are doing a special service in preserving and spreading it.

questions.question: What final lesson does the ending of the prayer give to a believer?
questions.answer: To finish with praise to Allah.
